coastal.title: Reservoir inflows in Comox Valley lowest in 64 years as warm, dry fall persists
coastal.description: Reduced water levels have prompted a variety of consequences — including a return to Stage 3 water restrictions, the temporary closure of a boat ramp and one conservation group monitoring for any impact to spawning salmon.

kamloops.title: B.C. woman who married ISIS fighter pleads guilty to terrorism charge
kamloops.description: Kimberly Polman pleaded guilty to one count of leaving Canada to participate in the activities of a terrorist group, the Public Prosecution Service of Canada confirmed.

kamloops.title: Kelowna's Taylor Ruck earns her 2nd silver at swimming World Cup
kamloops.description: Canadian swimmers Taylor Ruck and Finlay Knox added to their medal hauls Friday at the second stop of the three-meet World Aquatics Swimming World Cup series in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.

prince-george.title: Peace River North voters facing limited provincial political choices
prince-george.description: Voters in the Peace River North riding have just two choices in the 2026 provincial snap election: B.C. Conservative candidate Curtis Whitford or Independent candidate Jordan Kealy. No other candidates will be on the ballot, including representatives from the B.C. NDP or B.C. Greens.
